Upper East Region

Upper East

The details matter here: handwoven baskets, painted compounds, busy markets and the intelligence of things made to last.

A crocodile at the Paga pond · Photo: Knowledge and philosophy

Capital

Bolgatanga

Go for

Bolgatanga, basketry and earth-built homes

Good to know

Bolgatanga is renowned for weaving and market craft.
